opportunities.name: Acme Healthcare storage modernization
requirements: Replace aging primary storage arrays before end-of-support deadline (within 18 months)
High availability with no single point of failure for clinical systems
Disaster recovery with recovery time objective under four hours
Encryption at rest for patient data (HIPAA compliance)
Centralised management to reduce operational burden on a small IT team

notes: 2026-09-15: Initial inquiry received via web form. Director of Infrastructure requested information on storage modernisation options. No formal RFP issued.
2026-10-10: Introductory call held with Director of Infrastructure. Confirmed end-of-support concern and HA requirement. No budget figure shared. Agreed to schedule a discovery meeting.
post_meeting_notes: 2026-10-29: Discovery meeting held. Director of Infrastructure confirmed storage arrays reach end of support in Q2 2027. Medical imaging workloads identified as the highest-capacity consumer. Recovery time target of four hours stated explicitly. Budget discussion deferred — Director said CIO approval is needed for capital spend above a threshold they did not specify. Agreed next step: technical deep-dive session with the infrastructure team. Action: seller to send a summary and propose deep-dive date.
